$comment: Gzip budget of the web app's first load, checked by scripts/bundle-budget.mjs after the web build (CI: Web build). Measured 2026-10-26: entry 296 KB, entry and its static imports 663 KB. Raised to 695 KB on 2026-10-30 for replan-the-day (the missed-block count and packer that Day, Week and Today need before the lazy preview). Raised to 700 KB (entry 313 KB) on 2026-10-30 for calendar-frames: the frame occurrences, the bands behind the Day and Week blocks and the Plan-from-a-frame placement are drawn with the grid (about 3 KB); the Frames dialog is lazy, and lazy bands cost more in shared-chunk overhead than they saved. Raised to 705 KB on 2026-10-30 for calendar-slots (measured 702.8 KB): the slot block with its checklist and details, the slot rows of the phone agenda, the slot start in every list row's time column (TaskRow) and the Schedule sheet's slot choices are drawn on first load (about 4 KB, as design D11 estimated); a lazy details popover measured the same 702.8 KB, so it stays static. Entry raised to 314 KB on 2026-10-30 for bento-daily-check (measured entry 313.1 KB, first load 703.7 KB): the Bento read (sizes, the reconciled slots and the Frog or Summit order) is needed by the Focus engine in the shell, the Loop home and the Daily focus rows of How you work; changing a Bento, the slot rows and the slot menu load with the review screens. Raised to 707 KB on 2026-10-30 for task-energy (measured first load 705.5 KB, entry 313.5 KB): the energy read and its word on every row (TaskRow), the ~deep token in the quick-add parser and its suggestions, the energy filter terms in the parser and evaluator, and the Energy fact, submenu and choice are needed where tasks are drawn and typed (about 1.8 KB, under the 2 KB design estimate); none of it is a screen of its own to load lazily. Raise only on purpose, with the reason in the pull request.
